public.how.lead: Mbala mingi, moto akomaka etape na lobɔkɔ, mpe ezalaka ya sika kaka kino mbongwana ya nsuka. Awa, etangami na météo oyo ekomamaki, mpe mbongwana nyonso ebombaka bilembeteli na yango.

public.step.2.title: Zwa météo oyo elekaki
public.step.2.body: Ba température ya mokolo na mokolo mpo na esika ya elanga eutaka na archive ya Open-Meteo, banda kolona kino lelo.
public.step.3.title: Sangisa mikolo ya molunge
public.step.3.body: Mikolo ya molunge ya bokoli (GDD) esangisami na kotalela modèle ya molona. Soki motángo eleki ndelo, système elekisaka eleko na etape elandi mpe ekomaka ntina na yango.

public.about.title: Na ntina na
public.about.heading: Na ntina na Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis elandaka bilanga mpe milona ya ferme moko na Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Mpo na nini esalemaki
public.about.why.body: Ba étapes ya elanga ekómaka ya kala mpe mbuma ezwami ekomamaka na motó. Mecropolis etángaka eteni na nzela ya météo oyo ekomamaki. Motángo nyonso eutaka epai ya mosali to na source publique oyo nkombo na yango eyebani.
public.about.design.title: Ndenge esalemi
public.about.design.1.body: Growing degree days ebandaka kotángama na dati ya kolona, na ba données ya Open-Meteo. Mbongwana nyonso ya eteni ebombaka bilembeteli na yango: dati ebandaki, motángo mobimba ya GDD mpe esika eutaki.
public.about.design.2.body: Eteni oyo elandi liboso ya kobuka ebengami kokɔmela na molunge, mpo likambo ya kobuka mbuma ekomami te.
public.about.design.4.lead: Mitángo ya kokokanisa epesaka kaka likanisi.
public.about.design.4.body: Ebombamaka na mikanda na yango, elongo na source, unité mpe licence.
public.about.stack.title: Bisaleli
public.about.stack.body: Appli ya lokasa moko ya Vite mpe React 19 na Cloudflare Pages. Navigateur etángaka mbala moko ba données publiques ya Sanity na GROQ mpe eyokaka mbongwana mbala moko. Makambo ya kokoma mpe ba données ya sekele elekaka na Cloudflare Pages Functions, oyo etalaka cookie ya session oyo esinyami. Zod etalaka ba données na bokɔti mpe bobimi, Vitest esalaka ba tests, mpe Tailwind 4 ebongisaka ndenge emonanaka.
public.about.limits.title: Bandelo oyo eyebani
public.about.limits.1: Ba paramètres ya modèle ya milona (molunge ya ebandeli, molunge esengeli mpo ebima mpe ekɔmela) ekomami na mabɔkɔ mpe ezali naino na ba sources te.
public.about.limits.2: Motángo ya kokokanisa ya lupin eutaka kaka na HarvestStat ya 2000 tii 2007, mpe bokɔtisi ya liboso ezwaki mokanda moko te ya lupin.
public.about.limits.3: Ba données ya banyama mabe ezali mikanda ya GBIF ya zingazinga ya ferme. Elakisaka bisika bamonaki lolenge moko pene ya ferme.
public.about.limits.4: Demo ezali na compte moko ya kokɔta mpo na bato nyonso mpe epekisaka kosenga mingi na mémoire. Kokɔta ebombaka nkasa ya tableau, kasi ebatelaka ba données te: moto nyonso akoki kotánga yango. Kasi ebatelaka makambo nyonso ya kokoma.

docs.stages.title: Ndenge ba étapes elandanaka
docs.stages.intro: Bileko elekaka liboso na ba étapes motoba:
docs.stages.guards: Koleka na eteni mosusu ezali na mibeko. Eteni ya kolona esengi dati ya kolona mpe molona; eteni ya kokola esengi ndelo ya kobima na degree days; liboso ya kobuka esengi 90% ya ndelo ya kokɔmela; kokɔmela na molunge esengi kokóma na ndelo ya kokɔmela; botali esengi résumé ya météo ya eleko mpe motángo ya kokokanisa oyo endimami. Mibeko ya GDD esengi mpe ba données ya molunge mpo na ata 90% ya eleko. Mbongwana oyo dati na yango ezali na mikolo ekoya epekisami.

guide.title: Ndenge ya kosalela Mecropolis
guide.lead: Malako mokuse na maloba ya pɛtɛɛ. Elakisi ntina ya app, bato oyo bakosalela yango mpe mosala ya eteni mokomoko.
guide.what.title: Mecropolis ezali nini
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis elandaka bilanga mpe milona ya ferme. Etalaka esika molona ekómi na kobakisa molunge oyo ezwi banda balonaki yango. Elakisaka mpe météo, mabele mpe banyama mabe zingazinga ya ferme na esika moko.
guide.what.p2: Esalemaki mpo na ba ferme ya Western Cape na Afrika ya Sudi, kasi ekoki kosalelama na ferme nyonso, etúká nyonso mpe eleko nyonso.
guide.who.title: Ezali mpo na nani
guide.who.p1: Ezali mpo na moto oyo abatelaka bilanga, lokola mosali-bilanga, mokambi ya ferme to mopesi-toli.
guide.who.p2: Esɛngi te oyeba ordinatɛrɛ to makambo ya météo. Soki okoki kofungola site, okoki kosalela Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Mpo na nini kosalela yango
guide.why.1: Okoki komona mbala moko milona oyo euti kolonama, oyo ezali kokola mpe oyo ekómi pene ya kobukama.
guide.why.2: Osengeli te kobongisa elanga mokomoko na mabɔkɔ. App ememaka molona na etape elandi ntango météo elakisi ete ntango ekoki.
guide.why.3: Ekebisaka yo mpo na malili makasi mpe molunge ya mikolo ezali koya, mpe mpo na banyama mabe oyo emonani pene ya ferme.
guide.why.4: Makambo nyonso ya elanga, lokola nkisi oyo opanzaki, nyama mabe oyo omonaki to note, ebombamaka na esika moko elongo na dati mpo otala yango na nsima.
guide.why.5: Motángo mokomoko elakisi esika euti, mpo oyeba oyo okoki kondima.
guide.heat.title: Ndenge app eyebaka esika molona ekómi
guide.heat.p1: Milona ekolaka noki na molunge mpe malɛmbɛ na malili. Mecropolis etángaka molunge yango mokolo na mokolo lokola biteni ya molunge, oyo bato ya siansi babengaka growing degree days to GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Mokolo na mokolo, ezwaka katikati ya molunge ya likoló mpe ya nse, mpe elongolaka molunge oyo molona etikalaka kokola. Oyo etikali ezali biteni ya molunge ya mokolo wana. Mokolo ya malili ebakisi eloko te.
guide.heat.p3: Molona mokomoko esengeli kozwa motángo moko ya biteni ya molunge liboso ekóma pene. Ntango motángo banda balonaki yango epusani pene ya motángo wana, molona ekendaka na etape elandi.
guide.heat.p4: Molunge eutaka na Open-Meteo, service ya météo ya ofele oyo ebombaka météo ya bisika nyonso na mokili.
guide.stages.title: Ba etape motoba
guide.stages.intro: Molona nyonso na elanga nyonso elekaka na ba etape oyo, na molɔngɔ oyo.
guide.stages.planning: Eleko ebongisami, kasi molona ezali naino na mabele te.
guide.stages.growing: Molona ezali kozwa biteni ya molunge.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Molona ezwi pene na molunge nyonso oyo esengeli, yango wana ntango ya kobongama mpo na kobuka ekómi.
guide.stages.harvested: Molona ezwi molunge nyonso oyo esengeli, yango wana esengeli kozala pene. Kaka yo nde okoki koloba soki babukaki yango mpenza; app ebengaka yango kokɔmɛla na molunge.
guide.stages.review: Eleko esili mpe okoki kotala ndenge elekaki.
guide.stages.p2: App etalaka molona mokomoko butu nyonso mpe ntango moto abakisi likambo oyo amonaki to mosala oyo asalaki. Okoki mpe kofina Reconcile now na eleko mpo etala mbala moko.
guide.start.title: Ndenge ya kobanda
guide.start.1: Fungolá lokasa ya ebandeli. Okoki komona karte ya météo, mabele, banyama mabe mpe mbuma ya ferme ya ndakisa kozanga kokɔta.
guide.start.2: Finá Sign in na likoló mpe salelá makambo ya compte ya ndakisa oyo bapesaki yo.
guide.start.3: Poná ferme. Yango ekofungola tableau ya ferme wana.
guide.start.4: Finá eleko moko mpo na komona makambo nyonso ya molona wana na elanga wana.
guide.start.5: Salelá esika ya monɔkɔ na likoló ya lokasa nyonso mpo na kobongola monɔkɔ. App ekokanisa oyo oponaki mbala ekoya.
guide.home.title: Lokasa ya ebandeli
guide.home.p1: Lokasa ya ebandeli elakisaka karte ya etúká oyo balangi na kotalela molunge oyo mabele ezwi na eleko oyo. Elakisaka mpe météo ya sikoyo mpe ya mikolo ezali koya, mabele ya ferme ya ndakisa, banyama mabe oyo emonani pene kala mingi te, mpe mwayene ya mbuma ya etúká. Esɛngi te okɔta mpo na komona yango.
guide.dashboard.title: Tableau ya ferme
guide.dashboard.intro: Tableau elakisaka ferme moko. Biteni na yango ebandi na likoló tii na nse ya lokasa. Esika ya ferme na likoló esalisaka yo kokende na ferme mosusu.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Na mokuse mpo na ferme
guide.dashboard.summary: Motángo ya bilanga mpe ba ha ya ferme, bileko oyo ezali kotambola mpe milona oyo ekómi pene.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Esengeli kotala
guide.dashboard.alerts: Makebisi mikuse, lokola malili makasi to molunge na météo, molona oyo ekómi pene, eleko oyo ebandi na ntango te, to banyama mabe oyo emonani pene ya elanga. Likebisi mokomoko elobaka ntina na yango.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Ndenge ferme ezali
guide.dashboard.conditions: Météo ya lelo, oyo ekoya, mabele mpe banyama mabe pene ya ferme oyo.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Ndenge eleko ezali kokende
guide.dashboard.progress: Karte ya molona mokomoko oyo elakisaka molunge boni ezwi. Okoki kokokanisa bilanga pembeni na pembeni mpe kozwa liste lokola fichier ya tableau (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Bilanga
guide.dashboard.fields: Bilanga nyonso ya ferme, bonene na yango, mabele mpe milona na yango.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Luká makambo oyo ebombami
guide.dashboard.search: Komá na maloba ya mokolo na mokolo oyo ozali koluka, lokola ba pucerons na blé. Ekozwa makambo oyo emonanaki mpe misala oyo elimboli ndenge moko, ata soki bakomaki na maloba mosusu.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Batoli
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Misala oyo bapesi toli mpo na elanga, lokola kopanza nkisi to engrais. Okoki kondima to koboya mokomoko, mpe kotya ete esili ntango mosala esalemi.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Makambo ya sika
guide.dashboard.activity: Liste ya ntango molona mokomoko ekendaki na etape ya sika.
guide.season.title: Lokasa ya eleko
guide.season.intro: Eleko ezali molona moko na elanga moko na mbula moko. Lokasa na yango ezali na makambo nyonso.
guide.season.top.label: Likoló ya lokasa
guide.season.top: Molona, elanga, dati ya kolona, dati oyo bakanisi kobuka mpe mbuma ntango okokoma yango.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Ba etape ya molona
guide.season.pipeline: Ba etape motoba, mpe oyo ezali sikoyo etyami elembo. Finá Reconcile now mpo na kotala mbala moko soki molona esengeli kokende liboso.
guide.season.readiness.label: Makambo oyo esengeli mpo na kokende liboso
guide.season.readiness: Liste ya makambo oyo app esengeli na yango liboso emema molona na etape elandi, lokola dati ya kolona mpe ba données ya météo oyo ekoki. Likambo mokomoko elobi Pass, Warning to Blocked; soki ekangami, elakisi oyo ezangi.
guide.season.evidence.label: Bilembeteli
guide.season.evidence: Makambo oyo app esalelaki mpo na kozwa bikateli, mpo okoka kotala yango.
guide.season.propose.label: Pesá toli ya mosala
guide.season.propose: Pesá toli ya mosala mpo na elanga oyo, elongo na bilembeteli ya eleko. Ekotikala brouillon tii moto andima yango na tableau.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Graphique ya biteni ya molunge oyo ebakisami banda balonaki, mpe ligne ya motángo nyonso oyo molona esengeli.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Soki boye?
guide.season.whatIf: Meká dati ya kolona ya liboso to ya nsima, to eleko ya molunge mingi to malili mingi, mpe talá ndenge biteni ya molunge ekobongwana. Eloko moko te ekobombama.
guide.season.summary.label: Eleko na mokuse
guide.season.summary: Ndimbola mokuse ya makambo ya eleko oyo AI ekomi. Salelá yango lokola lisungi mpe talá makambo oyo ebombami soki eloko emonani mabe.
guide.season.notes.label: Ba note ya eleko
guide.season.notes: Ba note ya eleko oyo ezali na dati. Okoki kobakisa, kobongola mpe kolongola yango, mpe kozongisa version ya kala ya note.
guide.season.files.label: Fɔtɔ ya elanga mpe rapport ya ekzamɛ ya mabele
guide.season.files: Tindá fɔtɔ ya elanga mpe PDF ya ekzamɛ ya mabele oyo euti na laboratoire.
guide.season.log.label: Buku ya elanga
guide.season.log: Oyo omonaki na elanga mpe oyo osalaki kuna, lokola kopanza nkisi, nkombo ya nkisi mpe motángo oyo osalelaki.
guide.season.history.label: Lisolo ya mbongwana
guide.season.history: Mbongwana nyonso oyo ebombamaki na eleko oyo, elongo na dati na yango.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Mwayene ya etúká
guide.season.benchmark: Mwayene ya mbuma ya etúká oyo euti na mituya ya bato nyonso. Ezali mpo na kokokanisa, kasi ezali mbuma ya elanga na yo te.
guide.season.pests.label: Banyama mabe ya etúká
guide.season.pests: Banyama mabe oyo balobaki ete emonanaki pene ya elanga na GBIF, ebombelo ya bato nyonso mpo na makambo oyo emonanaki. Finá Fetch sightings mpo na kozwa ya sika.
guide.sources.title: Esika mituya eutaka
guide.sources.weather: Météo eutaka na Open-Meteo, mpo na lelo, mikolo ezali koya mpe mikolo eleki.
guide.sources.soil: Makambo ya mabele eutaka na SoilGrids, karte ya mabele ya mokili mobimba.
guide.sources.pests: Makambo ya banyama mabe oyo emonanaki eutaka na GBIF, ebombelo ya bato nyonso.
guide.sources.yields: Mbuma ya etúká eutaka na USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa mpe Banque mondiale.
guide.sources.you: Makambo mosusu nyonso, lokola ba note, misala mpe mbuma na yo, ezali oyo yo to bato na yo bokomaki.
guide.limits.title: Oyo ekoki kosala te
guide.limits.model: Biteni ya molunge oyo molona mokomoko esengeli ezali kaka makanisi na biso mpe emekami naino na elanga te. Salelá yango lokola litambwisi, kasi ndimá oyo omoni na elanga na yo.
guide.limits.maturity: Kokóma na ntango ya kobuka na kolanda molunge elingi koloba ete, na kolanda météo, milona esengeli ekóma. Kasi yo nde oyebi soki ekómi mpenza.
guide.limits.translation: AI nde ebongolaki maloba oyo. Esengeli ezala pɛtɛɛ mpo na kososola, kasi moto oyo alobaka monɔkɔ yango atalaki minɔkɔ nyonso te.
guide.limits.demo: Demo ezali mpo na bato nyonso. Kokoma makambo ya sekele kuna te.

dashboard.picker.empty: Elanga ezali naino te. Salelá script ya kobakisa makambo ya ebandeli.
